scope: Current factual package for the post-9-October-2024 Wintertodt activity. It proposes future normalization only: no route timing, low-Hitpoints setup, game count, points, rewards, supplies, loot, rates, survival, collection-log progress, or stop condition is asserted.

included: Current entry, travel, Warmth, attacks and formulas, solo/group loop, tools, food, warm clothing, roots, kindling, braziers, pyromancers, rejuvenation potions, Construction repair, reward-points and reward-cart mechanics, rewards, protections, death boundary, attention, dependencies, and proposed account observations.
The 2024 Warmth and Reward Cart changes are treated as current mechanics. Existing shared records wintertodt-reward-cart and action:wintertodt are reuse targets rather than duplicate authorities.
excluded: A final Ironman route, whether to do Wintertodt early, a preferred Firemaking target, solo versus group preference, food plan, exact game duration, XP or reward rate, an assumed reward-search level, crate/cart opening schedule, collection-log target, or any universal stop condition.
Community tactics are retained only as explicitly unscored strategy-candidate-not-fact observations.

minigame_gate.boostability: No temporary-boost claim is made here; record an observed eligible Firemaking state before entry.

minimum_functional_tools: tinderbox or Bruma torch to light a brazier
recommended_but_not_entry_gates: up to four currently recognized warm items
food that heals at least 4 Hitpoints or local rejuvenation potion
hammer or Imcando hammer for optional brazier repairs

location_and_transport: Wintertodt Camp is north of Great Kourend; entry to the prison is through the camp.
The camp bank and current Reward Cart are outside the prison. Travel can use a previously unlocked Kourend/Zeah route, a player-owned-house portal, spells, jewellery, transport networks, or a walk.
Travel method, charge state, current location, bank contents, camp visit, and ability to return after a death are separately observed.

unlock_transition.from: observed Firemaking eligibility plus physical arrival
unlock_transition.to: permission to enter a Wintertodt attempt
unlock_transition.determinism: Entry does not prove survival, points, successful subdual, reward balance, or any loot.

entry_inputs.requirement: Bring or have access to an axe and tinderbox; Bruma torch is a source-backed tinderbox alternative. The current prison supplies bruma-root, bruma-herb, unfinished-potion, brazier, and pyromancer interactions but does not create permanent owned tools.

entry_inputs.consumed: Any food that heals at least 4 Hitpoints restores 35% Warmth per food-heal event; a rejuvenation-potion dose restores 30% Warmth. Food with two separate healing events restores Warmth twice.
entry_inputs.requirement: Food is optional preparation, not a survival guarantee. Rejuvenation potions are locally craftable and Brew'ma can combine ingredients when Druidic Ritual is incomplete.

A knife can fletch bruma roots into kindling. A hammer or Imcando hammer can repair a broken brazier where the player can perform that interaction. Neither is an entry requirement or proof of a completed action.

reusable_setup.detail: Each recognized warm item adds 1% per-minute passive Warmth regeneration, up to four; four is also the maximum reduction count W for attack formulas. Extra warm items provide no further Warmth benefit.
Any usable axe can cut bruma roots. A wielded axe can free an inventory space. Axe tier, Woodcutting state, cut speed, and ownership are observed, not inferred.
Both can light a brazier. Bruma torch is an inextinguishable warm light source and can be used off-hand after the 2024 update, but it is an RNG reward and is never assumed.
Observed pieces may affect Firemaking XP while worn; the set is neither access nor survival protection and no piece is inferred from activity participation.

warmth_and_damage.current_model: Since 9 October 2024, Warmth is the resource damaged inside the prison. Hitpoints is not substituted into Wintertodt damage formulas. At 0% Warmth, the player dies immediately.

restoration.food: Food healing at least 4 Hitpoints restores 35% Warmth per healing event.
restoration.rejuvenation_potion: One dose restores 30% Warmth; four doses can restore 120% across separate uses.
restoration.passive: Base regeneration is 8% Warmth per minute plus 1% per recognized warm item, maximum four.
restoration.other: Health-regeneration effects, Rapid Heal, Heal Other, Ring of life below 10% Warmth, and Phoenix necklace at or below 20% can affect recovery/escape as documented. Possession, activation, timing, and outcome are observed.

formula_definitions.W: recognized warm items worn, capped at 4
formula_definitions.B: lit braziers, capped at 3 for the formula

event_boundaries: Standard attack has a 10-tick cooldown, interrupts fletching and brazier feeding, and does not interrupt cutting roots.
Area snowfall warns over a 3-by-3 area and can be avoided by moving before it falls.
Standard attacks are more frequent at higher Wintertodt energy; brazier and pyromancer attacks are more frequent at lower energy.
Formula availability does not infer the player was hit, avoided a hit, restored Warmth, survived, died, or was ready for any mode.

common_loop: Enter a live prison, cut bruma roots, optionally fletch roots to kindling, light or feed active braziers, optionally repair a broken brazier, and optionally heal a damaged/incapacitated pyromancer with rejuvenation potion.
Each lit pyromancer weakens Wintertodt; player count, lit brazier count, energy progression, attack timing, execution, points, duration, and result vary per observed game.
A game ends when Wintertodt is subdued or when the attempt fails. Start/end state and outcome must be reported.
solo_and_group_loop.group_boundary: Multiple players can contribute independently. A populated world is not a guarantee of any personal point total, survival, result, XP, queue/wait time, or reward balance.
solo_and_group_loop.solo_boundary: A solo attempt changes player-managed energy, braziers, pyromancers, supplies, timing and attention demands. It is not a fixed deterministic rotation in this model.

energy_and_contribution.energy: Wintertodt begins at 100% energy. Pyromancers channel bruma flames to lower energy while associated braziers are lit. Current strategy mechanics document each active pyromancer weakening 1% every 14 ticks; concurrent player/brazier state remains observed.

experience.boundary: Requires a player-observed valid repair interaction; do not infer a house, level, repair or XP.

energy_and_contribution.threshold: At least 500 personal points in a successful subdual is required for a Reward Cart entitlement and the 100x Firemaking-level completion XP. Less than 500 grants no reward entitlement. No run is deemed qualifying until its observed outcome and personal points are recorded.

completion_or_reward_events.condition: Observed Wintertodt subdual and at least 500 observed personal points.
completion_or_reward_events.result: Record the player-observed Firemaking XP and Reward Cart roll delta. At 500 points, two reward rolls are guaranteed. Each additional 500 points guarantees one extra roll, and points between 500-point milestones create a linear chance for another: 1% per five points past the previous milestone.
completion_or_reward_events.boundary: For example, 750 points is two rolls plus 50% chance of a third and 1,000 points is three rolls. This supplies a rule only after observed points/outcome; it does not generate points, a roll, crate, success, or balance automatically.

completion_or_reward_events.condition: Observed Reward Cart balance of at least one and player-initiated search.
completion_or_reward_events.result: Consume one observed stored reward roll and record one exact observed result. A Big-search handles five searches as five independent observed rolls. Cart retrieval proceeds at one reward per three ticks and the cart stores at most 8,000 reward rolls.
completion_or_reward_events.boundary: Roll table rates make items obtainable only. Material quality is determined when searching, based on then-current relevant skill levels, never on the game date or a planned level.

failure_and_death.subdual_failure: A non-subdued/failed attempt and a successful attempt below 500 personal points grant no Reward Cart entitlement. Previously accumulated cart rolls are a separate observed balance.
failure_and_death.warmth_death: Dropping to 0% Warmth causes instant death. Wintertodt does not make a permanent-account survival or death assertion. Standard game-mode death, grave, item-loss, Hardcore status, location, reclaim and fee consequences must be observed under the separate death/reclaim model.
failure_and_death.local_state: Damaged braziers and incapacitated pyromancers are encounter state, not player-owned permanent damage. A local potion, root, kindling, food or tool state is not carried into account inventory unless explicitly observed outside the encounter.
failure_and_death.reward_reclaim: The Reward Cart is an external persistent storage counter, not an inventory item or a grave. A death does not automatically resolve its balance, its recovery, or the player position.

repeatability.cycle: Each live game is an independent observed attempt. The current Reward Cart replaces the pre-2024 separate Supply Crate inventory loop; stored rolls can be searched later, subject to the 8,000-roll capacity.
repeatability.rng_boundary: No game count, points, reward-roll count, loot result, unique, supply quantity, XP, survival or collection-log entry is produced from a plan or expected rate.

currencies.spend_behavior: Qualifying observed subduals produce a threshold/fractional chance result from personal points; a search consumes one observed roll. It is a persistent counter with 8,000 maximum capacity, not an item stack, crate or guaranteed game output.
Locally prepared/reported doses can restore player Warmth or heal pyromancers. Ingredient supply, creation, use, effect and remaining amount are observed.

utility: A searched reward roll can yield material-table outputs including logs, seeds, herbs, ores, fish, gems, coins, saltpetre and dynamite.
Material categories scale by associated skill at search time: Woodcutting, Farming, Herblore, Mining, Fishing and Crafting respectively.
rewards.protection: Skill scaling changes probability/availability; it is not a guarantee of a selected item, quantity, account supply or economic result.

utility: Recognized warm gloves for the four-item warmth rule.
rewards.rate: 1 in 150 per reward-cart roll before prior-table exclusions.
rewards.protection: After three owned pairs, a successful warm-gloves roll becomes a magic seed. This is duplicate conversion, not a guarantee of gloves or seeds.

utility: Inextinguishable warm light source and tinderbox alternative for Wintertodt.
Can be equipped off-hand after the 2024 update; 50 Firemaking is required to equip.
rewards.rate: 1 in 150 per reward-cart roll before prior-table exclusions.
rewards.protection: After three owned torches, a successful Bruma-torch roll becomes torstol seeds. This is duplicate conversion, not a guaranteed alternative output.

utility: Hood: 0.4%, garb: 0.8%, robe: 0.6%, boots: 0.2% Firemaking XP while worn; complete outfit adds 0.5%, for 2.5% total.
Each piece is a Wintertodt collection-log item.
rewards.rate: 1 in 150 per reward-cart roll before prior-table exclusions.
rewards.protection: The reward selects the least-owned piece; ties use Garb, Hood, Robe, Boots. Magic-wardrobe-stored pieces count while a treasure-trail-stashed robe does not. This balances piece rolls but does not guarantee a full set by a specified roll count.

utility: Off-hand Tome of fire utility is governed by its item facts; burnt pages supply charges.
rewards.rate: 1 in 1,000 per reward-cart roll before prior-table exclusions.
rewards.duplicate_exchange: An observed Tome of fire can be exchanged with Ignisia for 250 burnt pages. This does not prove a player wants to exchange it or has one.

utility: Charge an observed Tome of fire; each page provides 20 charges under tome mechanics.
rewards.rate: 1 in 45 per reward-cart roll before normal material-table fallback.
rewards.quantity: 7 to 29 on a successful burnt-page roll.

utility: Dragon axe is a Wintertodt obtainable item with separate equip and special-attack gates.
Also has independent monster-drop acquisition paths.
rewards.rate: 1 in 10,000 per reward-cart roll before later table resolution.
rewards.protection: No Wintertodt pity, deterministic purchase, or guaranteed duplicate conversion found.

utility: Phoenix pet and Wintertodt collection-log item; cosmetic/pet state is observed.
rewards.rate: 1 in 5,000 per reward-cart roll; increased fifteenfold at 200 million Firemaking XP.
rewards.protection: No deterministic purchase or pity route found. The 200 million modifier does not infer XP or pet ownership.

utility: Excess observed Wintertodt uniques, excluding burnt pages and Phoenix, can be exchanged with Ignisia for either an extra supply crate or 50 burnt pages.
Extra supply crate has no unique-item rolls but may still yield dragon axe.
rewards.boundary: The selected duplicate, exchange choice, crate contents, dragon-axe result and collection-log state are all observed. This is not an automatic duplicate disposal rule.

dependencies_and_bypasses.detail: Current stated participation gate. Record eligibility before entry; do not infer temporary boost behavior.
Cutting bruma roots needs an axe. Type/ownership/cut speed are separate facts.
Observed torch can replace a tinderbox and can occupy off-hand; it is not an entry prerequisite.
Up to four recognized warm items affect formulas and passive regeneration. They do not bypass Warmth, mechanics, attention or death observation.
Restoration options improve Warmth management, but do not certify survival or complete a game.
Optional root-to-kindling conversion changes point/XP mechanics and needs player actions; it is not a required route.
Optional broken-brazier repair path; it does not ensure a broken brazier, repair, Construction XP, or success.
Without the quest, Brew'ma can combine potion ingredients; quest state does not dictate whether a potion is made or used.
A qualifying observed 500-plus-point successful subdual adds observed stored reward-roll entitlement.
Reward-cart search can roll a piece at the documented rate; no full-set timing is guaranteed.
Reward-cart search can roll an empty Tome at the documented rate; other acquisition paths remain independent.
Reward-cart search can roll a Dragon axe; monster drops are alternative acquisition routes.
Reward-cart search can roll Phoenix at the documented rate, without a deterministic finish.

logout_or_idle_constraints: Warmth loss, standard interruptions, avoidable 3-by-3 snowfall, brazier damage, pyromancer incapacitation, energy progression, point target and game ending require responses.
The 2024 interruption grace window and Warmth resource do not make a full encounter low-attention or safe to leave unattended.
Exact click cadence, time-to-failure, food/potion use, group pressure, solo rotation, completion rate and banking cadence are player- and mode-observed.
afk_and_attention.source_boundary: Current sources establish an interactive/reactive encounter. Community descriptions such as chill, AFK, safe, easy solo, or low-supply are strategy candidates rather than account-independent classifications.

community_strategy_observations.claim: Old Ironman guides often instruct players to keep 10 to 17 Hitpoints and rush Wintertodt before questing because pre-2024 cold damage used Hitpoints. The claimed low-Hitpoints advantage is obsolete after the Warmth Meter update.
community_strategy_observations.boundary: The current model must not recommend a low-Hitpoints account, infer a player's Hitpoints, or use Hitpoints to calculate Wintertodt damage. Whether to train Firemaking at any account stage remains scoring work.

community_strategy_observations.claim: Solo rotations may intentionally manage braziers, pyromancers, Wintertodt energy, roots, kindling, potions and point thresholds to seek a chosen reward-roll pattern; group worlds may trade control for shared completion pace.
community_strategy_observations.boundary: No solo rotation, points/game, games/hour, food cost, completion chance, XP rate, safety claim, or preferred mode is adopted. Those depend on current player state, execution and activity population.

community_strategy_observations.claim: Players sometimes delay Reward Cart searches to raise relevant material-scaling skills, while others search early for immediate supplies, GP, outfit rolls or Tome chances.
community_strategy_observations.boundary: Claim-time level scaling is factual. Waiting, searching, banking, desired material mix, claimed value, and desired account timing are separate strategic choices. The current cart is not the old inventory of one Supply Crate per game.

community_strategy_observations.claim: Community Ironman guides propose targets such as an early Firemaking level, a supply amount, a full Pyromancer outfit, Tome of fire, Dragon axe, Phoenix, or a collection-log milestone as a Wintertodt stopping point.
community_strategy_observations.boundary: All cited targets are preferences with RNG and opportunity-cost exposure. No target implies current possession, expected rolls, required activity count, or a route stop.

state_boundaries: Entry eligibility is distinct from current camp location, tools, warm items, food, potion doses, house/Construction state, travel, world population, active game, mode, points, energy, braziers, pyromancers and Wintertodt energy.

The post-2024 Warmth meter is independent from Hitpoints. Never infer Warmth loss, healing, passive recovery, potion use, Ring of life/Phoenix-necklace activation, survival, death, grave, reclaim, lost item, Hardcore status or readiness from a planned activity.

A successful subdual, personal 500-point threshold, roll delta, fractional-roll result, XP, active-game failure and cart balance require account observations. Formulae validate reported values; they never synthesize a result.

Reward Cart results are selected at search time. Associated skill levels determine material-table probability only; a stored roll never guarantees a material, quality, unique, duplicate conversion, quantity, GP, supply, collection-log row or future utility.

Unique ownership, warm-item count, Tome pages/charges, Bruma torch slot/version, Pyromancer-piece storage state, Dragon axe usability, Phoenix pet and all collection-log entries require explicit player confirmation.

The 8,000 cart capacity is a factual limit, not evidence of a player's balance or an instruction to bank/search. Current Reward Cart storage replaces historical one-Supply-Crate-per-game inventory assumptions.

facts.summary: Consolidate current access, Warmth formulas, restoration, attacks, loop, points, XP, threshold, failure/death boundary and repeatability. Supersede only stale Hitpoints-era wording after central review.
Reconcile existing wintertodt-reward-cart with current stored-roll, 500-point, 8,000-cap, claim-time scaling, search and duplicate-conversion details without auto-generating rewards.
Normalize observed unique acquisition paths and utility, collection-log boundaries, duplicate handling and independent alternative sources.

actions.requirements: Observed Firemaking eligibility and player-confirmed physical activity access; use optional observed tool/supply state as readiness detail, not automatic eligibility proof.
actions.transition: Keep observation-only. Record an explicit attempt, selected mode if known, outcome, points, Warmth/death report, XP and Reward Cart delta only when reported. Do not infer any output, completion or reward.

actions.requirements: Observed cart-roll balance of at least one and player-initiated search.
actions.transition: Subtract one observed roll and record exactly one observed reward result. Rates are informational and produce no automatic item. Big-search must be represented as five independent searches.

actions.requirements: Player reports the completed or failed attempt.
actions.transition: Validate report shape and, only where complete facts are supplied, the deterministic threshold/roll calculation. Preserve unreported Warmth, events, actions, XP, points, death and rewards as unknown.

actions.requirements: Observed eligible duplicate unique, selected Ignisia exchange, and explicit choice of extra crate or 50 burnt pages.
actions.transition: Consume selected observed item and record selected observed exchange result; opening an extra crate remains a distinct RNG observation.

graph_edges.evidence: successful observed subdual with observed 500-plus personal points only
documented 1-in-150 piece roll; no set guarantee
documented 1-in-10,000 Dragon axe roll; no guarantee
warm item and tinderbox alternative; restoration still requires observed player actions
individual observed pieces are collection-log entries

account_observations.rule: Report-only. Do not calculate survival, success, attempt count, points, XP, cart delta or duration from intent or a strategy.

shape.last_searches: array of player-recorded exact result descriptors

account_observations.rule: A snapshot can be partial. Reject only invalid reported bounds; never infer missing game state or a cart result.
Use existing possession, quantity, charges, equipped, condition, collection-log and reclaimable conventions. Store reported ownership only.
A possible drop, duplicate conversion, activity attempt or stored Reward Cart balance never confirms a collection-log row.
Keep death-system consequences distinct from the encounter. No reclaim fee, item loss or account-mode transition is inferred.

conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: Many legacy guides calculate Wintertodt damage from Hitpoints and recommend rushing the activity at low HP. Since 9 October 2024 current Wintertodt damage consumes Warmth and formulae use base Firemaking, warm items and lit braziers. Do not carry historical low-HP rationale into current score or readiness logic.

Current rewards are stored Reward Cart rolls, not one carried Supply Crate per qualifying game. Any old crate-banking assumption must be replaced with observed cart-roll balance and separate search events. Extra supply crates from Ignisia remain a distinct exchange result.

Existing facts wintertodt-reward-cart and action:wintertodt are deliberately untouched. Their high-level observation boundary is compatible, but a central integrator should reconcile source IDs, current 2024 mechanics, detailed formulas and proposed account fields without duplicated canonical facts.

The source establishes 4x Construction-level XP for a valid brazier repair, but this package intentionally does not automate a repair gate, house state, hammer ownership or expected repair count. Preserve repair/XP as observed until a dedicated Construction interaction contract resolves it.

Reward rates do not produce expected roll counts, completion time, target level, utility value, collection-log finish or stop condition. Individual current skills alter material probabilities at search, so opening timing is a future scoring problem after account observations.
